newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Wing Tai gets partner for hotel site.
newsitem.headline: Wing Tai gets partner for hotel site.

text.p: Property-based Wing Tai Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday it has reduced its interest in the Cockpit Hotel site.
A company statement said Wing Tai's interest in two joint venture companies, Winpeak Investment Pte Ltd and Wingem Investment Pte Ltd has been reduced to 45 percent from 50 percent previously.
The beneficial interest of Straits Steamship Land Ltd in these two companies has increased to 10 percent from five percent.
Winpeak had successfully tendered for the Cockpit Hotel site and is holding 40 percent of the interest in the acquisition in trust for Wingem.
Wing Tai said the shareholders of Winpeak and Wingem are identical but it did not disclose their identities.
